name: kbd
title: Kbd
description: A keyboard key or shortcut shown as text: a <kbd> in the code type role on an inset background, with KbdGroup for combinations.

manifest.name: kbd
manifest.title: Kbd
manifest.description: A keyboard key or shortcut shown as text: a <kbd> in the code type role on an inset background, with KbdGroup for combinations.
manifest.usage: Use Kbd in help text, menus and tooltips to show a key (Esc) or, with KbdGroup, a shortcut (Ctrl + K). Write the separator between the keys as text (+, then). Kbd shows a shortcut; it does not bind one. For a symbol (⌘, ⇧) add hidden text that names the key.

props.name: children
props.description: The key's label, as text or an <svg aria-hidden> with hidden text.

props.name: render
props.description: Base UI render prop: render another element with the key's props and classes.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: group
slots.description: KbdGroup, the outer <kbd> of a combination; data-slot="kbd-group".

parts.name: KbdGroup
parts.description: Lines up the keys of one shortcut with their text separators, in text.caption and color.fg.muted.

accessibility: Renders <kbd>, which marks keyboard input; KbdGroup is an outer <kbd>, as HTML nests the keys of a combination.
Screen readers read the key labels and the text separators; write "Ctrl", not an icon alone.
A <kbd> takes no aria-label: give a symbol (⌘) visually hidden text (sr-only) and mark the symbol aria-hidden.
Not focusable and not interactive; nothing to operate.
color.fg.muted on color.bg.inset is contrast-checked as text by the token build.
